# ADR-0034 §2.3 gains the first-run setup broker: six named capabilities, main's credential custody, the unwired effect

## Context

ADR 0034 §2.3's falsifier: *any leaf needing a renderer capability the preload cannot express through a named, allowlisted intent amends THIS section first.* neomjs/neo-agent-institution#384 (PR neomjs/neo-agent-institution#441, the cockpit's first-run setup card) adds six `setup*` capabilities to the packaged shell's preload — the vessel's main process evaluating the first-run recipe, recording consents, keeping a credential and (once neomjs/neo-agent-brain#765 is pinned) running host effects through the Brain's host-effect module. Item 8 was amended the same way for `verifyPlane()` (#19362 → PR #19363, for neomjs/neo-agent-institution#446); the setup broker has no item yet (the PR's review, RA-4, names the gap).

## The Problem

Six preload capabilities ship with their consuming leaf and no record in the shell ADR of their payload/result boundaries, the sender check, where a credential lives after main's window, and what the effect channel does while the Brain's orchestration is not pinned. The named allowlisting meets the implementation shape; the contract is undocumented.

## The Fix

Item 10 under §2.3, *The first-run setup broker is a named broker*, after item 9 (the credential window), amended `2026-10-02, #<this> — for neomjs/neo-agent-institution#384`:

- the six capabilities, each `ipcRenderer.invoke('shell-setup-<name>')`, every handler validating the sender per §2.3.4 and refusing by name a browser boot (`not-packaged`) and a boot without a Brain root (`no-brain-root`): `setupEvaluate({target})` → the recipe's evaluation (the CLI's `--json` shape) for the run's target; `setupProbe()` → the placement probe's JSON; `setupPresets()` → the preset table; `setupAnswer({stepId, answer})` → one consent for a CHOICE question, the re-evaluated run; a credential question is refused on this route; `setupCredential({stepId})` → main's credential window (item 9), the value kept as an owner-only file under the host setup root's `credentials/`, the file's PATH recorded as the consent, the reply `{evaluation, path}` — no value crosses in either direction; `setupEffect({effectId})` → one consented host effect through the Brain's shared orchestration, else a named refusal (`unwired: …`) and the card's row becomes the operator's instruction.
- the record custody: ADR 0041's one host record per run under the host state root; the broker is the run's one writer while the shell holds it, its record operations serialized; the CLI resumes the run when the shell is gone.
- the renderer never holds a value, a path it did not receive from main, or a stored status: every row it shows is main's fresh evaluation.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 Item 10 names the six capabilities with their payload/result boundaries, the sender check, the two named refusals, the credential custody (window → owner-only file → the path in the record) and the unwired-effect behavior, with the amendment anchor (`#<this> — for neomjs/neo-agent-institution#384`).
- [ ] AC-2 The item cites ADR 0041 for the record and item 9 for the window; nothing else in the ADR changes.
- [ ] AC-3 neomjs/neo-agent-institution#441 cites this PR as its prerequisite (merge order: this first).

## Out of Scope

The broker's code (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#441) and the effect wiring (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#440).
